Our Sacred Temple

Shri Baglamukhi Mata & Khatu Shyamji

Shri Baglamukhi Mata Mandir is a beacon of divine power and devotion, serving the community for over seven decades. Our temple is blessed by Maa Baglamukhi — the tenth Mahavidya, goddess of power — and Shri Khatu Shyamji, together providing divine protection and blessings to all devotees.

We blend ancient Vedic traditions with modern convenience — now offering online bookings for all poojas, hawans, and rituals through certified and experienced pandits.

Our Presiding Deity

Shri Khatu
Shyamji

Shri Khatu Shyamji is revered as the "Haare Ka Sahara" (support of the defeated). Devotees believe that whoever comes to His feet with a pure heart never leaves empty-handed.

The divine presence of Shyamji at our mandir blesses devotees with courage, prosperity, and protection. Special bhog and aarti are offered every Monday and on Ekadashi.

Monday
Special Bhog
Ekadashi
Special Aarti
Phalgun
Grand Mela
